content.title: Shape Of My Heart

alternatives.text: "Shape of My Heart," a poignant and enigmatic track from Sting's 1993 album "Ten Summoner's Tales," masterfully weaves the metaphor of card playing to explore existential queries. The song's haunting guitar riff and introspective lyrics delve into the mystical logic of chance, presenting a philosopher-gambler who seeks to uncover hidden laws governing fate. This nuanced composition showcases Sting's profound storytelling.
